widgets_values:
# Image → 3D (Pixal3D + TRELLIS.2)

This workflow turns a single input image into a textured 3D mesh:

1. **BiRefNet** cuts the subject out of the background
2. **MoGe-2** estimates geometry/normals from the image
3. **CLIP Vision** encodes the image as conditioning
4. **Pixal3D / TRELLIS.2 diffusion models** generate the 3D asset, decoded through the **VAE**


## Setup
Download all models below and drop each file into the folder listed under its link (all paths are relative to your ComfyUI install). The two diffusion models share `models/diffusion_models/` — pick the one you want in the loader dropdown. After copying, restart ComfyUI or refresh the model lists so they show up.

For questions join our **Free Discord** here: https://pixel-artistry.com/discord


# Model Downloads

## 1 · CLIP Vision✅
[⬇ Comfy-Org/Pixal3D → clip_vision](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/tree/main/clip_vision)

📂 `ComfyUI/models/clip_vision/`

---

## 2 · Diffusion Model (Pixal3D)✅
[⬇ Comfy-Org/Pixal3D → diffusion_models](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/tree/main/diffusion_models)

📂 `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`

---

## 3 · Diffusion Model (TRELLIS.2)【还没安装这个】
[⬇ Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2 → diffusion_models](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/TRELLIS.2/tree/main/diffusion_models)

📂 `ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/`

---

## 4 · VAE✅
[⬇ Comfy-Org/Pixal3D → vae](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Pixal3D/tree/main/vae)

📂 `ComfyUI/models/vae/`

---

## 5 · Geometry Estimation (MoGe-2)✅
[⬇ moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors (direct)](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MoGe/resolve/main/geometry_estimation/moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors) · [ℹ Model page](https://comfy.org/p/supported-models/moge-2-vitl-normal-fp16/)

📂 `ComfyUI/models/geometry_estimation/`

---

## 6 · Background Removal (BiRefNet)✅
[⬇ birefnet.safetensors (fashn-ai)](https://huggingface.co/fashn-ai/BiRefNet/blob/main/birefnet.safetensors)

📂 `ComfyUI/models/background_removal/`

---

## Folder overview
```
ComfyUI/models/
├── clip_vision/          ← Pixal3D clip_vision
├── diffusion_models/     ← Pixal3D + TRELLIS.2 diffusion models
├── vae/                  ← Trellis2 VAE
├── geometry_estimation/  ← moge_2_vitl_normal_fp16.safetensors
└── background_removal/   ← birefnet.safetensors
```

> After copying the files: restart ComfyUI or refresh the model lists (R).

nodes.title: 01 原始图片 · 在这里更换素材
01 通用补全与优化 · Qwen 2511
widgets_values:
将参考图片中最主要的独立物件整理为用于单图生成 3D 模型的完整资产参考图。如果有人物，优先选择人物正在持握、使用或展示的主要物件，不保留人物。

尽量保留目标物件原有的形状、比例、结构、颜色、材质和可见纹饰。移除人物、手部、前景遮挡及无关物品，依据可见结构和现有风格，合理补全被遮挡或超出画面的部分。不要添加无依据的装饰，不要重新设计物件。

改善模糊和噪点，使边缘连续、细节自然清晰。选择能够清楚展示主要结构的视角，避免过强透视；让完整物件居中入画，四周留有适当空白，不裁切任何部位。使用均匀柔和的光照和纯浅灰背景，避免明显投影。

最终仅展示一个完整物件，不要文字、水印、边框、拼图或多视图。

nodes.title: 使用说明
widgets_values:
运行顺序：原图 → Qwen补全优化 → 图像预览/保存 → BiRefNet抠图 → 1024主体裁剪 → Pixal3D形状/材质 → 网格后处理与贴图烘焙 → GLB。
预览节点不会暂停执行，点击运行会继续生成3D。若需先检查图片，可先对图像预览节点使用部分执行。
同一工作流反复换图即可。Qwen默认标准40步，enable_turbo_mode打开后为Lightning 4步。
3D参数沿用当前Pixal3D_test：形状1536、重建768、目标100万面、贴图2048。
优化图：output/object_asset_pipeline/edited；模型：output/object_asset_pipeline/models。
